text:
alex: heads up — we're getting multiple customers confused when console shows 'degraded' but SDKs only see a generic 5xx. they can't tell if it's a routing fallback, quota, or model failure.

priya: agreed, this keeps coming up in support threads. do we have distinct end-to-end signals today?

sam: fragments exist: runtime tags route_reason, billing logs show quota, and traces show model OOMs. but no single client-visible contract.

jordan: runtime does emit `X-RW-ROUTE` in some paths but SDKs drop unknown headers. we need a stable, compact header contract that SDKs and console can depend on.

lisa: here's a lightweight proposal: two headers — `X-RW-FailMode: ok|degraded|throttled|unavailable` and `X-RW-Reason: <short-code>`. SDKs surface enums, console shows reason details.

priya: example short-codes?

sam: e.g. `routing_fallback_pool_full`, `quota_exhausted_tenant`, `model_oom`, `upstream_timeout`.

alex: also include `Retry-After` for throttles. console should display the human copy for the short-code and link to billing/runbook when it's a quota.

jordan: telemetry additions: emit `failmode`, `route_origin` (primary|fallback), `route_variant` (model-v1|model-v1-quant). sample: p95/p99 low-overhead tags, full headers+stack for 1% requests.

lisa: SDK UX: default mapping `degraded` => warn + `on_degrade` callback. let apps opt into showing end-user friendly messages for `quota_` reasons.

priya: product teams ask for explicit tenant quota wording: "your tenant budget is exhausted" vs generic degraded. short-code approach supports that without leaking platform internals.

sam: rollout plan: dual-write for a period. runtime emits both old `route_reason` metric and new headers. SDKs read new headers if present else fallback to metadata. console queries sampled logs for header display. name feature flag `ff/transparent-failmodes`.

jordan: telemetry migration required: backfill sampled logs last 30d to map legacy tag values to the new short-codes so dashboards stay consistent.

lisa: runbook snippet for users: "Degraded responses indicate the request was routed to a compatibility model or lower-capacity pool. Expect higher latency and potential quality variance. See route details or pin a model." keep it short and action-oriented.

priya: console badge proposal: green/yellow/red for OK/Degraded/Throttled. hover reveals `X-RW-Reason` friendly string; if reason starts with `quota_`, show a quick link to billing and quota docs.

alex: owners: runtime — sam & jordan; SDKs — lisa; console — priya; docs & runbook — alex. I'll open RFC and track RW-3579.

ops-bot: Ticket created: RW-3579 - "Client-visible failmode headers & console mapping" by alex — assigned: sam, jordan, lisa, priya. Priority: P2.

jordan: tiny nit: shorten header name? `X-RW-FailMode` is already short. confirm we standardize on `X-RW-FailMode` and `X-RW-Reason` (canonical long names documented).

lisa: fine. pls include exact enum strings in RFC and SDK contract tests.

sam: i'll post legacy path checklist (where route_reason was null) and plan dual-emission by EOD.

priya: i'll update mockups and add the cross-join query for telemetry workbook.

alex: target: staged rollout next week behind ff, with unit tests and sampling in place. keep followups in RW-3579.

alex: thanks all. short action items: 1) runtime dual-write + header list (sam), 2) SDK enum mapping + tests (lisa), 3) console badge + hover text (priya), 4) RFC + runbook copy (alex).

lisa: one more: ensure we don't expose internal hostnames in the friendly reason. sanitize mappings before display.

sam: yes — short-codes only. full internal metadata stays in logs but not in client headers.

alex: perfect. I'll draft RFC now.

priya: thanks — assigning mock review to lisa for copy.

ops-bot: RW-3579 updated: status set to "In progress".

alex: end."
